scenario.label_zh: 安排雕像展台评估与搬运
scenario.goal_zh: 说明雕像重量与现有底座问题，约定先评估底座再由专业人员搬运

context_zh: 社区展馆即将接收一尊石雕，策展人莱奥妮和设施主管讨论旧展台的外观及承重问题，不自行移动重物。
author: author-phase06-b

sentences.speaker: Leonie
sentences.text: The delivery sheet says the statue weighs half a ton. Can we put it on the old display stand?

sentences.speaker: Facilities Manager
sentences.text: We don't know whether that stand can support it. We need a proper assessment before arranging the move.

sentences.speaker: Leonie
sentences.text: It's an ugly stand anyway, with that bright plastic cover. Could we use a different base?

sentences.speaker: Facilities Manager
sentences.text: Possibly, but appearance isn't the main issue. I'll ask our facilities engineer to assess the options, then get the specialist movers involved.

sentences.speaker: Leonie
sentences.text: Please do. I'll tell the delivery team to hold it at their warehouse until we have an approved base and a moving plan.
